paragraphs.text: Quopomma was a soldier during the Dark Age of Dominaria .

Quopomma was one of Maeveen O'Donagh 's two lieutenants, serving ultimately under Vervamon . An ogre , Quopomma was built like a brick, with massive, powerful arms and a towering stature. Maeveen had once seen her knock out every single member of a tavern brawl and then calmly go back to drinking her beer. Although she was loyal to Maeveen and followed her commands, Quopomma did not have much respect for Vervamon, thinking the scholar to be irresponsible and oblivious to the danger he put himself and others in. Throughout her journeys, Quopomma kept talking to some unknown beings who were either invisible or imaginary. Although Maeveen thought it peculiar, she accepted this fact about Quopomma and did not think any less of her lieutenant for it.
